name: fponly-p2
description: An F-P-only ply-2 field (analyst 6.61, the cheapest decisive test after the batch-size read): base-probit-p2's F-P (1,584 games a cycle among F-P x2, cluster trees x2, DAGs x2) was 37-55 below probit-late-p2's F-P (720 games a cycle among F-P x2 and T-P-Ne x2, the trees level with the flats) at ply 2 and 47-83 above at ply 1, at equal versions. Two accounts: COMPOSITION (6.61: weaker play inside the trainee's own distribution, base's weaker same-stream siblings, corrupts its labels; weaker foreign play is neutral, as diversity-p2 showed) or VOLUME (more games a cycle at ply 2 hurts the ply-2 strength per version). F-P x4, seed 51, ply-2 field, self-games, games_per_cycle 1584 (the batch of base-probit-p2 and diversity-p2), floor 300, cap 400, hybrid16 games, hybrid6 training. Read at equal versions (v300 and the final) against base-probit-p2's F-P (composition factor, equal batch) and probit-late-p2's F-P (volume factor, same-quality siblings) at plies 1 and 2. Predictions (6.61, ply 2 / ply 1, ±28): F-P x4 minus bfp 20-60 / -60..-20; minus pfp within 30 at both. Kills both quality accounts: within 15 of bfp at ply 2 and 30+ below pfp; then the harm is volume per cycle at ply 2 and the 1,584 standard should drop to ~720 for ply-2 fields.
